### Observed differences

- The five activities A19, A20, A25, A26 and A27 keep roughly the same participation — each appears in about 17–24% of cases before and about 19–22% in the later window, with the five shares summing to about one occurrence per case in both windows — but they are executed much earlier: their mean relative position moves from about 0.60–0.64 of the trace to about 0.34–0.36. [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- Their order against A28 and A29 flips: before, A28 and A29 came before A19/A26/A27 in essentially all joint occurrences (about 20–24 in 100 cases, reverse order about 0 in 100); in the later window, A19/A26/A27 come before A28/A29 (about 19–22 in 100 cases). [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006]
- Before, A29 and A30 each passed to one of the five activities in about half of their observed outgoing transitions (A29 about 48%, A30 about 51%); in the later window both hand over almost exclusively along the main chain (A29→A30 about 98 in 100, A30→A34 about 98 in 100), and the A29→A34 distance shortens from 3 steps (about 98 in 100) to 2 steps (about 97 in 100). [DIR006, DIR007, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- The five activities' own outgoing transitions change accordingly: before they led mainly to A34 and A30; in the later window they lead almost only to A28 (about 93–100% of observed outgoing transitions), with A20 immediately followed by A28 in 38 traces where before only 2 such observations existed. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG002]
- A47's successor changes: before it was followed directly by A28 (about 91 in 100 outgoing transitions, at 1 step in about 92 in 100 cases); in the later window it is followed by one of the five activities (about 17–21% each) and reaches A28 only at 2 steps (about 92 in 100). [DIR008, LAG009]
- Minor: A28 and A29 themselves occur only marginally later (mean relative position about +0.02–0.03), consistent with one of the five activities now running just before A28. [POS006, POS007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the block of five alternative activities — A19, A20, A25, A26 and A27, with about one of them executing per case in both windows — is placed earlier in the flow in the later window: it now runs between A47 and A28 near the start of the case, whereas before it ran later, in the segment between A29/A30 and A34, interrupting the A29 → A30 → A34 sequence. This is shown directly by the position shift (mean relative position about 0.62 to about 0.35), the flipped order against A28 and A29, the successor changes at A29, A30, A47 and the five activities, and the new A47 → five → A28 chain alongside the tightened A29 → A30 → A34 chain. All 30 qualified control-flow items point to this one pattern, roughly 50 times the ~0.6 expected by chance in an unchanged process, and every item ranks above about 99.5 in 100 reference comparisons, so sampling variation cannot account for the set as a whole. [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG002, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009]

Limitation: the evidence shows order and adjacency, not occurrence identity — it cannot fully rule out that the five activities were removed from the late segment and separate occurrences inserted early, rather than one block moving; the complete absence of interleaved or repeated orderings and the stable one-per-case participation make a single relocation the best reading. A few distance details after the change (A19→A34, A20→A34, A29→A19, A29→A20) rest on a single observed case each and are weak on their own; the conclusion rests on the items backed by all 200 cases in both windows. [LAG001, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005]
